create_AWQMapping: create an AWQMapping dataclass to define activation smoothing and weight balancing for a layer
build_default_mappings: build a list of default AWQMapping entries for standard transformer architectures like Llama and Qwen
build_moe_mappings: build a list of AWQMapping entries for MoE architectures like Qwen2Moe and Qwen3Moe
lookup_model_mappings: lookup the correct AWQMapping list from the registry for a given HuggingFace model class name
create_ResolvedMapping: create a ResolvedMapping dataclass linking resolved PyTorch modules for activation smoothing at runtime
